text:
You need a project manager who can keep SPA personnel, stakeholders, and third-party vendors aligned so projects move forward on time, within scope, and with clear documentation and escalation paths.

I can help bring that structure to your operational cycles. With 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, and workflow-focused systems, I’m comfortable working in technical environments where coordination, scope control, and reliable delivery matter. While my background is technical, the work has consistently involved organizing moving parts, managing dependencies, and keeping the end user experience and delivery timeline in focus.

One relevant project was a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics, where I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with the full context. That project used Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio, and it required strong agent orchestration and tool-calling logic to keep interactions smooth. The result was 43% of conversations resolved without an agent, with CSAT at 4.4 out of 5.

I would bring the same disciplined approach to project coordination: clear scoping, structured timelines, careful monitoring of progress, and prompt issue escalation when needed. I’m comfortable working across stakeholders, maintaining organized project documentation, and adapting plans when scope, schedule, or priorities change. I also understand the importance of keeping delivery predictable while balancing quality, resources, and communication.

If selected, I would focus on:
- establishing clear project scope and milestones
- coordinating resources and keeping stakeholders aligned
- tracking risks, blockers, and timeline changes early
- maintaining thorough project documentation
- ensuring smooth communication between internal teams and external partners

I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can support your project management needs and help keep your client projects moving efficiently toward successful outcomes.
